To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: New supplier onboarding — Arborio Logistics (banking + PO)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Attached are the forms you requested to set Arborio up as a vendor: a completed bank authorization, our signed W-9, and a sample invoice. We prefer ACH for payments but can accept wire for first-run if needed.

Summary of bank details (attached is the bank_authorization_form.pdf):
- Bank: GreenPoint National Bank
- Account name: Arborio Logistics LLC
- Routing (ACH): 122000661
- Account number: ****5678 (full account in attachment)

We typically require the PO number on invoices to avoid remittance delays — if Redwood issues a PO, please let us know the format you prefer. Also confirming our remit contact: accounts@arborio.com.

Attachments: bank_authorization_form.pdf (pdf), w9_arborio.pdf (pdf), sample_invoice_0928.pdf (pdf)

Let me know if your finance team needs the bank letter from our bank or a notarized authorization.

Best,
Tyler
Director, Finance
Arborio Logistics

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tyler Hansen <tyler.hansen@arborio.com>
Cc: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — Arborio Logistics (banking + PO)

Tyler — thanks, received everything and appreciate the clear packet. I copied Laura (Finance) and Ben (Payments) to get the supplier record created and schedule a micro-deposit. Our standard onboarding steps are below, and I added the onboard checklist for your visibility.

Next steps (for transparency):
1) Finance (cc'd) will create the supplier and run ACH micro-deposits to validate the account (typically 1-2 business days after they kick off).
2) Once micro-deposit confirms, Finance will mark you active and provide the Redwood PO template/number for your first invoice.
3) If micro-deposit fails, we'll fall back to wire for the initial payment; Laura will advise.

Please confirm: preferred remit string on the invoice (we saw "Arborio Logistics LLC" on the W-9) and whether you need invoices routed to a specific PO prefix. If you can add "RWD-PO-####" or the PO number once we send it that helps our AP match automatically.

Attachment: vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

I'll leave the operational details to Laura/Ben — Laura, could you start the supplier record and kick off verification? Ben, FYI on routing labels and invoice matching rules.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Forwarding Arborio's packet. Key items for setup: bank auth, W-9, sample invoice. They prefer ACH and request PO on invoices.

Action items for Finance (Laura):
- Create vendor record under "Arborio Logistics LLC" and link tax id from W-9.
- Initiate micro-deposit to routing 122000661 / acct ****5678.
- Set remit preference to accounts@arborio.com and configure invoice auto-match for PO prefix "RWD-PO".
- Confirm expected activation date and any holds (e.g., if bank letter/notary required).

Ben — please add the following invoice label rule once vendor is active: label invoices containing "RWD-PO" -> auto-apply PO match; otherwise route to AP review.

Attachments forwarded: bank_authorization_form.pdf, w9_arborio.pdf, sample_invoice_0928.pdf

Thanks — would like to have them active for the scheduled run next Friday if verification completes.

-Steph

From: Tyler Hansen <tyler.hansen@arborio.com>

Cc: accounts@arborio.com

Hi Stephanie / Laura / Ben,

Thanks — confirmed: ACH is our preferred method and the attached signed ACH authorization (signed_ach_agreement.pdf) should suffice for verification. We can accept a wire if you need to clear on the first run, but ACH is our standard going forward.

Remit string preference: "Arborio Logistics LLC / INV#" — please include that on the PO so our remittance engine routes correctly.

If you need a bank letter I can request one, but we've had success with the authorization PDF + W-9 in other setups. Please send the micro-deposit test amount when it goes out and I'll confirm receipt.

Looking forward to the PO reference so we can submit the invoice for the pilot month.

Best,
Tyler
